title: Frankův tým: Temný den pro baseball (S18E09)
title_en: Frank's Team: A Dark Day for Baseball
plot: Paddy sponzoruje místní dětský baseballový tým, aby si vylepšil image.(Disney+)

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: Nevím jestli v tomhle díle víc zabíjí Charlie, který konstantě pojídá semínka a nepije k tomu žádnou vodu do bodu, kdy není jeho hatmatilce rozumět, nebo Dennis jako komentátor. Tohle je peak of S18. (...) "I'm sorry, I don't understand my own racism." (Mac xd) (...) "Would you stop spitting those seeds at me? Also, are you eating the shells and spitting out the seeds?" "I don't know what's going on. Yeah, that might be it." (...) "I want you to lay down the suicide squeeze." (...) "Well, Timmy, looks like we are in for a good one today as the Paddy's Pinstripes have replaced their entire starting lineup with what appears to be international talent." "An unorthodox move. Almost as unorthodox as Dennis Reynolds, a man I've never met, joining me in the booth today, folks." "That's right, Tim, and with approximately 84,000 children abducted each year, you do wanna be careful. That said, uh, 93% of those children do turn out to be runaways, so the numbers are in your favor." "It's a strange and disturbing factoid, Dennis." (...) "Uh, fun fact, elongated noodle arms are 57% more prone to dislocate and 92% when their owner has weak ligaments and shit posture, not to mention the sheer amount of alcohol abuse. And she's a bitch and a bird. Back to you, Tim." (...) "And in comes ICE."(15.10.2026)
